race.title: McCarthy Construction Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: A progressive winner in bumpers, OLD HABITS shaped encouragingly starting out over hurdles when third at Perth 5 weeks ago and, with this stiffer track promising to play to his strengths, he could well take full advantage of the weight he receives from fellow useful prospect Hidden Mountain , who was impressive at Worcester 3 weeks ago. Point winner's Moltezuma and Justoneglance are others to note. OLD HABITS (IRE) HIDDEN MOUNTAIN MOLTEZUMA (IRE)
